_meta.purpose: Labelled evaluation set: 15 scam + 15 genuine. Run the pipeline on each and report TP/TN/FP/FN in docs/EVAL.md.
_meta.note: All phone numbers, UPI IDs and suspicious domains are fictional. Genuine messages are modelled on real formats.
_meta.label_rule: scam = should be high_risk; genuine = should NOT be high_risk (no_strong_indicators or unable_to_verify are both acceptable)

hard_cases_to_discuss_in_EVAL_md: s13 (UPI collect) and s15 (OTP request over call) have no link: tests that Gemini reasoning, not URL rules, carries the verdict.
s14 (family impersonation, Assamese) has no link and no organisation: pure social engineering.
g02 contains a VPA and 'Not you? Call': genuine but superficially similar to scams; tests false positives.
g13 mentions OTP/PIN/password but as a warning: tests that keywords alone don't trigger high_risk.
